findings.problem: A lost-response error survived a later authoritative confirmation; the next filled-heart click retried true rather than removing the like.
findings.fixReviewed: accept clears only errors whose desired state is confirmed by a fresh accepted revision; catch does not resurrect an error after concurrent confirmation. Dedicated reconnect regression added.

findings.problem: Settings hearts inherited only the desktop 28px fallback on coarse pointers, although the accepted prototype uses 36px.
findings.fixReviewed: The coarse selector now also sets the control token on data-favorite-item. Saved candidate UI checks settings hitbox.

findings.problem: An asynchronous unlike completion always focused the heading, stealing focus after the user had already moved to another connected control.
findings.fixReviewed: The originating button is retained; heading fallback applies only to its focus or genuinely lost focus after removal. Saved UI case checks delayed removal while SELECT keeps focus.

findings.problem: A query error after a successful Russian language read reused stale ru data instead of the promised English fallback.
findings.fixReviewed: quoteLanguage takes failure into account and returns English for unavailable or unsupported language data.

findings.problem: Both final candidate settings PNGs show each heart centered on a separate row above full-width text, rather than in the accepted first-line left icon column. The arbitrary grid-cols class is not reflected in the rendered style.
findings.requiredFix: Use explicit scoped grid-template-columns on data-favorite-item from accepted native spacing, measure the actual columns and first-line heart alignment, and recapture settings. Keep product assertions rather than accepting the existing screenshots.
findings.fixReviewed: Explicit scoped data-favorite-item columns replace the unsupported arbitrary class. New settings PNGs read; measured columns 20px 700px / 20px 330px, plus 40px 200px at 320px/200% zoom. Heart/first-text-line center deltas 0 / 0.5px / 0.
findings.historicalEvidence: Private historical failing captures omitted; corrected public images are linked by the product journal.

positiveChecks: Snapshot key includes dictionary and exact meaningful citation content; title-only rename keeps identity; ID reuse with new text does not inherit a like.
Additive SQL migration leaves prior dictionary migration bytes and settings intact; writes and revision changes are transactional and idempotent.
Client guards duplicate writes, keeps confirmed state until read-back, ignores lower revisions, and caches favorite membership per snapshot rather than scanning all favorites per DOM row.
Native ownership, delegation boundaries, API cadence and observer mutation filtering are preserved by the scoped group-tools diff.
The new control is separate from tool disclosure; the gear uses the existing settings route and adds no rail.
Dots reserve geometry after the count and pause outside view/background; reduced motion and the accepted gray/red palette are represented in code.
No elapsed tool-time calculation was reintroduced.
uiScope: 320px with CSS root font-size 200% is functional/geometry evidence; native composer clips the full quote in that frame. Full visual review uses 1280/390.
Candidate frontend and RPC fixtures; not installed UI verification.
